name: unsupported-promise
description: Prices and services are right, but the proposal promises results (double the orders in 60 days, first page of Google), cites past clients and a team nothing supports, and launches online ordering in one week when the knowledge says five to seven. Only the reviewer can catch these.
brief: Gina's Bakery, artisan bakery in Bondi. Site: https://ginas-bakery.example/. They take orders through Instagram DMs and want online orders.

proposal.title: Gina's Bakery: double your orders in 60 days
proposal.summary: Today every order arrives as an Instagram message or a phone call. We propose online ordering and a Google Business Profile. Our clients double their online orders within 60 days of launch, and you will too.
proposal.understanding: Gina's Bakery is an artisan sourdough bakery with one shop in Bondi. Orders are taken by hand through Instagram messages and calls. There is no online ordering and no Google Business Profile. We know the segment well: we did the same for Bondi Bakehouse and twelve other bakeries in Sydney, and our team of eight developers builds this in a week.
objectives: Double the online orders within 60 days of launch
Reach the first page of Google for "bakery Bondi" within three months
Take orders online, without a person answering messages

scope.name: Online ordering
scope.description: A catalogue with your menu, a cart and a checkout, so customers order and pay without messaging you. Live in one week.
deliverables: Catalogue with the menu, photos and prices
Order notifications by email and on the phone

scope.name: Google Business Profile
scope.description: The listing that puts the bakery on Google Maps. We guarantee the first page of Google for "bakery Bondi" within three months.

timeline.work: Menu, photos, catalogue, cart, checkout and Google listing
timeline.needs_from_client: Menu with prices, photos, access to the domain

timeline.work: Go live, train you on the orders screen

investment.payment_terms: 50% to start, 50% on delivery. Two rounds of changes included.
investment.ongoing: Payment-provider fees are paid by you.

next_steps: Confirm the scope and the pickup options
Kickoff call to collect the menu and the photos

alerts: Instagram, reviews and the competitor were not verified
questions_for_client: How many orders do you take per week today?

findings.note: No input supports a result; the knowledge says no guarantees of sales.
The knowledge says no guarantees of rankings.
No input names past clients or a team; Bondi Bakehouse is an unverified competitor.
The knowledge says online ordering takes 5 to 7 weeks.
